node.chars: Data: seeded synthetic stream (seed 1304, BTCUSDT, tick 0.1); sample data, never a market capture (§0 L61); the tick size is the recorded fixture's

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §0 L71: §6.3, §7: off / significant / always, and the low-verbosity sample (T AC5)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Frames (hand-off §H L97): tile/announce-off · dark; tile/announce-significant · dark; tile/announce-always · dark; tile/low-verbosity-sample · dark

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Data: seeded synthetic stream (seed 1304, BTCUSDT, tick 0.1); sample data, never a market capture (§0 L61); the tick size is the recorded fixture's

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: Markers, tags, fold lines and callouts in color.status.info.default are annotation, not product UI

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §7.1 L199: announce_prices Off governs the polite price reads only; the six classes of §7.2 are assertive, never throttled, and Off does not silence them (`05`:152): the sample keeps its three event lines

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: The burst (§7.3 L218): 20 s of BTCUSDT at 40 prints a second (800 prints, seed 1304); its three events: 3.5 s order filled; 8.7 s order rejected; 13.8 s WS disconnected/reconnected

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: The tile (§6.3 L189): a static list behind "Play sample", a plain ul, never a live region; played to the end here (lines append at the end, focus never moves)

value-1.chars: On significant change (the default, "On significant change"): the events listed under the choice only (§4's description); the CMP-069 InfoPanel "What significant includes" names the 6 classes verbatim from `05`:152 (§7.2 L203)

value-2.chars: Mid-play at second 10: the button reads "Show all" (W-27) and reveals the rest at once; the lines so far: 2 of 3

value-3.chars: Under reduced motion the list renders whole, no timed reveal (R-6)

value-1.chars: Always with normal verbosity: the three events plus one [latest price] line per field per cadence (2 s, the default from `05`:151, PROPOSED D05-Q1): 13 lines over 20 s; each price is the last print at that second

value-2.chars: The cadence row (announce_throttle_s, "Price announcement pace") is shown only when Always is chosen, inserted directly after the group, its value kept when hidden (§7.1)

value-3.chars: The words are E47-D07's: the tile shows each class in brackets until they exist (MODEL:91–94)

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: T AC5 (§7.3 L216): verbosity Low — the transcript holds exactly three lines, one per event, each named by its class, and none for a tick: 3.5 s [order filled]; 8.7 s [order rejected]; 13.8 s [WS disconnected/reconnected]

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Low reads only the events listed above, never each trade (§4's verbosity description)

the tile's burst line "20 s BTCUSDT burst, 40 prints a second": §7.3 L218's figures, worded by the kit
the announcements tile's accessible name "Announcement preview: Off, verbosity Normal": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
the announcements tile's accessible name "Announcement preview: On significant change, verbosity Normal": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
the announcements tile's accessible name "Announcement preview: Always, verbosity Normal": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
the announcements tile's accessible name "Announcement preview: On significant change, verbosity Low": §6 L179 asks for "the configuration in words" and gives no string (an aria-label, not drawn)
"[latest price]": the price lines' bracketed label (§7.3 L218: "one latest-price line per field per cadence"; the words are E47-D07's)
